feature_contract.goal: Preserve original vehicle-selection texture and child-mask UV identity across native get_texture→put_sprite_ex2, preventing null/failure, stale recycled pointers, cross-pack lookup and unrelated direct sprite draws from supplying a foreign selector UV transform without altering original managed texture loading or draw behavior.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only UI replacement lookups and native put_sprite_ex/put_sprite_ex2 lifetime; preserve correct paired mask/parent replacement, ordinary no-replacement game sprites, original COM returns, UV restore, R84, R26_SAFE, input/FFB, F11, GOAL/+TIME, SkyGlow, DX11 and frozen DXVK.
trace_stages: Original vehicle selector xstset loads DDS through UI replacement/native decoder and publishes a per-slot original-to-replacement sprite_scales ratio only on viable DDS inputs.
Original get_texture texture-pointer/slot pair is now captured as a bounded two-lookup parent/mask window; failed lookup or new xstset destroys unproven binding.
Original put_sprite_ex2 consumes the exact window before native callbacks; only non-null exact matched parent and child COM identity may use existing transient UV scale with scoped restoration.

Unmatched/failed/earlier native put_sprite_ex cannot promote an old selector texture into a later user's UI UV; game Draw, source sprite queue semantics, R84 x86 and OpenXR host are otherwise unchanged.
subcomponents: Replace stale global prevTexture/prevMaskTexture pointer reuse with bounded texture submission owner and fail-closed invalid original lookups.

Scope both original parent and mask UV transaction to one native sprite submission, expire parent/mask on xstset changes and direct-sprite-family consumes without losing fresh reentrant get_texture bindings.
Compile constexpr positive parent/mask and negative failed lookup, unrelated identity, one-shot re-use, unscaled parent valid mask, cross-pack reset regression paths.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: Known valid UI DDS parent/mask lookups retain original UV and matched replacement scaling only during the correct native sprite call; false null/foreign matches fail closed.
Failed lookup, newer pack, direct sibling, and later pointer reuse cannot consume a stale selector UV binding; unmatched sprite and original device input/FFB stay unchanged.
Final validation-bearing exact SHA completes required Actions Gate; Quest3 real white-texture/selector and mask test remains separate.

diagnosis.original_evidence: The original native vehicle selector uses consecutive get_texture texture source/mask lookups and parent/child SPRARGS2; current fork used previous COM pointer identities without a consumption epoch.
diagnosis.root_cause: Previous get_texture state could survive failed/null lookup, unrelated sprite submission, or pack reload. Null source and null saved pointer compared equal and could look up valid slot zero, allowing a foreign sprite or selection mask to acquire stale replacement UV ratios.
source_trace: Original source DDS/slot → UITextureReplacement D3DX loader and sprite_scales → get_texture_dest pointer association → put_sprite_ex2_dest parent/child scoped UV rewrite → original native Draw and R84 eyes.
The new one-shot get_texture lookup expires at native sprite entry, failed lookup and successful xstset switch; paired legitimate mask and parent remain distinct.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: No stereo owner widened and no GPU eye route promoted; this fixes source texture/UV pairing before the original R84 draw. Quest3 white-sprite optical proof remains pending.
alternatives_rejected: Do not force white selection sprites into ScreenHud or widen generic UI stereo classification.
Do not retain address-only mask cache across an unknown number of native sprite submissions or change game DDSTexture/FFB/SkyGlow fallback.
Do not infer that static C++ binding repair proves every white selector symptom resolved.

ci_evidence.status_note: C6 BUILD_VERIFIED exact SHA after same-task verifier failure repair; not an HMD visual PASS or new score.
